decisions.statement: Work handed in is run in slices rather than in a single call.
A slice is bounded by a share of the frame the game is drawing.
A time here is seconds read from the game's own frame and update clocks.
Nothing here reaches the Lua `os` table.
A task has a callstack of steps rather than a Lua coroutine.
Another addon reaches this library only through the global name.
The debug logger is used where the debug logger is loaded and skipped otherwise.

definition: a shared scheduler running other addons' work a slice at a time across frames
